card.name: Separators in lists of statin names
card.fires_on: Commas or arrows right after a statin drug name in a list of statins, just before the next statin (e.g. atorvastatin, fluvastatin, lovastatin). Weaker hits occur at a few other spots, such as inside a drug name or after 'dosage'.

modes.label: Between statins in a list
modes.description: The comma or arrow separating one statin from the next in lists of HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors.
modes.example: HMG-CoA Reductase Inhibitors: atorvastatin, fluvastatin, lovastatin<<,>> pr

modes.label: Other scattered spots
modes.description: Occasional hits partway through a drug name or on 'of' after 'recommended dosage'.

card.writes: It suppresses endings of other drug names (azole, idine, amide, ium), so the next word is less likely to be another drug-name ending.
card.plain: It marks the gap between one statin name and the next in a list of cholesterol drugs.
